title: Two Friends Cram for a Statistics Exam
script: Rani: [panicked] Bayu, I still don't understand this statistics chapter, and the exam is tomorrow morning.
Bayu: [calmly] Okay, let's slow down. Which part is confusing you the most right now?
Rani: Standard deviation. I read the definition five times, and it still doesn't make sense to me.
Bayu: Let's try an example instead of the definition. Do you understand what an average is?
Rani: Yes, that part is easy. It's everything after that gets confusing.
Bayu: [patiently] Standard deviation just shows how spread out the numbers are from that average. That's really all it means.
Rani: Okay, so a small number means the data is close together, and a big number means it's spread out?
Bayu: [relieved] Exactly. You explained it better than our textbook did.
Rani: That actually makes sense now. Why didn't anyone explain it that simply before?
Bayu: Sometimes textbooks make simple ideas sound complicated. It happens to me too, honestly.
Rani: Can we go through one more practice problem together before I go home?
Bayu: Of course. Let's use the data from question three, the one about exam scores.
Rani: Okay, I'll calculate the average first, then figure out the differences.
Bayu: [focused] Good, take your time. There's no rush tonight, we have a few more hours.
Rani: Thank you for staying late to help me with this. I was starting to panic before you arrived.
Bayu: That's what study partners are for. Besides, explaining it helps me remember it too.
Rani: Deal. Next time you're stuck on something, I'm helping you.
Bayu: [grateful] I'll hold you to that. Now, back to this problem, let's finish it together.
Rani: Honestly, I don't think I could pass this exam tomorrow without your help tonight.
Bayu: [encouraging] You would have figured it out eventually. You just needed someone to slow the pace down with you.

options: It is another word for average
It only applies to large numbers
It shows how spread out the numbers are from the average
quiz.explanation: Bayu explains that standard deviation shows how spread out the numbers are from the average.

quiz.explanation: Rani promises that next time Bayu is stuck on something, she will help him.

quiz.explanation: A concrete example makes the difficult words easier.

quiz.explanation: Bayu uses the phrase to explain distance from the average.

quiz.explanation: She begins with the idea she already understands.
